summary: Design Therapeutics, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose biomarker and clinical data from its ongoing Phase 1/2 RESTORE-FA trial evaluating DT-216P2 in Friedreich ataxia. This is a routine clinical trial update disclosure, not a special situation. No terms, recommendations, advisors, or transaction mechanics are involved. The filing reports dose-dependent frataxin increases and clinical improvements, with plans to pursue a registrational path. As a clinical data release, it does not trigger any special-situation category such as acquisitions, divestitures, or restructuring.
